{{Quote|What shall I do now that I have you? Skin you alive? Feed you to the beasts of Nathema?"<br />"Like father, like daughter. You're just as crazy and bloodthirsty as he was."<br />"I'll take that as a compliment.|Nexia Kirill meets her father's killer|<ref name="Nathema" />}}
'''Nexia Kirill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] daughter of [[Harridax Kirill]], a former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] known as "the Voidwolf" who became the [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] the Voidwolf was killed by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] working for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and Nexia swore to do whatever it took to hunt down and kill her father's murderer.<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nexia Kirill appears during "The Nathema Conspiracy" flashpoint only if [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] is a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who made the Light Side choice to pledge Voidwolf's pirate fleet to the Republic towards the end of their class story. In this case, Nexia Kirill will seek revenge on them and join the [[Order of Zildrog]] led by [[Vinn Atrius]], only to be sacrificed as fuel to awaken [[Zildrog]] by [[GEMINI 16]] on [[Nathema]]. If the smuggler makes a Dark Side choice to keep the fleet for themselves, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sumalee]] will appear instead of Nexia Kirill, while the other classes face antagonists from their own class stories.<ref name="Nathema" />
